summary: Backend engineer with 5 years shipping containerized Python services on PostgreSQL, with Apache Airflow pipeline ownership and hands-on Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform operations experience.

bullets.text: Built the Python REST API gateway fronting the pricing service, backed by PostgreSQL.
Wrote and tuned PostgreSQL migrations and indexes for the pricing service under production load.
Maintained Apache Airflow DAGs for the daily settlement reconciliation pipeline.
Provisioned infrastructure with Terraform and shipped every service as a Docker image.
